```yaml
name: Mobile Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: '2.7'
        bundler-cache: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

    - name: Run migrations
      run: bin/rails db:migrate

    - name: Run model tests
      run: bin/rails test test/models/family_test.rb

    - name: Run controller and model tests
      run: bin/rails test test/models/family_test.rb test/controllers/onboardings_controller_test.rb

    - name: Run RuboCop
      run: bin/rubocop

    - name: Build assets
      run: bin/rails webpacker:compile

    - name: Run feature tests
      run: bin/rails test test/features

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
      with:
        name: RSpec
        path: coverage/reports
        reporter: rspec
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/mobile-release.yml` sets up a CI/CD pipeline for the `we-promise/sure` repository. It includes steps to checkout the code, set up Ruby, install dependencies, run database migrations, execute model and controller/model tests, lint the code with RuboCop, compile assets, run feature tests, and upload test results. The workflow triggers on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch.
